item.title: Lacasa announces Annual Luncheon on March 25
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- Lacasa has announced its 2026 Annual Luncheon on Wednesday, March 25, beginning at 12 p.m. at the Lerner Crystal Ballroom.

item.title: Two men arrested after pointing firearm at pedestrian
item.description: MICHIGAN CITY, Ind. -- At approximately 4:05 p.m. on March 6, the La Porte County Regional Dispatch Center received a 911 call regarding two males who were pointing firearms at another person in the 400-block of Ridgeland Avenue.

item.title: Mario Cart competition held at Ninja Golf
item.description: GRANGER, Ind. - A Mario Cart competition was held on Sunday at Ninja Golf for gamers to show their love for Super Mario.

item.title: Former Notre Dame leprechaun presents at Rockne Series event
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The History Museum invited former Notre Dame leprechaun, Mike Brown, to give a presentation as a part of the Rockne Series.

item.title: Unity Gardens hosts Haircuts and Hotcakes for families in need
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Unity Gardens held Haircuts and Hotcakes on Sunday bringing haircuts to local families in need.

item.title: Man arrested after fleeing deputies, abandoning Mustang in cornfield
item.description: STARKE COUNTY, Ind. -- On March 6, the Starke County Sheriff's Department witnessed a red Ford Mustang with a black roof, and a temporary Indiana registration accelerate in speed.

item.title: Youth mental health supported at Elkhart County Children's Summit
item.description: GOSHEN, Ind. -- Advocates and community members who serve youth across Elkhart County will gather on Friday, March 13, for the annual Elkhart County Children’s Summit, a day dedicated to strengthening youth mental health.

item.title: “Anybody that needs a hot meal”, Edwardsburg community rallies after major storm
item.description: EDWARDSBURG, Mich. -- As the village of Edwardsburg brings to recover following a deadly storm on March 6, community members are stepping in.

item.title: Venues Parks and Arts hosts 23rd annual mother and son dance
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Venues Parks and Arts will host the 23rd annual mother and Son Dance on Thursday, March 19, from 5:30 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. at the Morris Performing Arts Center.

item.title: Man recalls experience inside Menards when tornado hit
